notes.title: Update 4.0 - The Level Editor Update
notes.content:
[p]This update adds the Level Editor with Steam Workshop support for custom levels as well as some minor changes and bug-fixes. 
[/p][list][*][p]Added the Level Editor and Steam Workshop support[/p][/*][*][p]Limit boxes now correctly lose magnetism visually[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the rightmost box in 8-3 to no longer be partially magnetic[/p][/*][*][p]Added move playback option to debug menu[/p][/*][*][p]Created collection of example levels made with the editor[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3554292012"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 3.0 - Rework Update
notes.content:
A large content update that changes a lot of levels that I felt didn't work in the first half of the game, removes unintended solutions that made later levels way too easy, as well as some other miscellaneous changes to prepare for the upcoming level editor update.
Any levels that were altered in some way will be uncleared on the level selection when the update is first opened, as well as marked with a *. 
[list]
[*] Undo can now be held down
[*] Undo now always rewinds to a state before any boxes are in motion, this prevents odd glitching behavior when moving and undoing while a box is in motion
[*] Boxes now prioritise the newest magnet encountered when moving
[*] Magnets can no longer be moved while they are moving a box (prevents movement speed from affecting the outcome of a movement)
[*] Removed unintended solutions ([spoiler]1-7,2-2,3-5,4-3,4-10,5-2,7-3,7-5,7-10,8-5[/spoiler])
[*] Altered level geometry to make some levels more interesting ([spoiler]1-3,2-3,2-9,3-1,3-3,4-5,6-2,6-4,7-4,0-1[/spoiler])
[*] Completely redesigned some levels ([spoiler]2-6,2-8,3-9,4-6,4-7,4-8,5-6,6-10,0-3[/spoiler])
[*] Reworked most levels of World 4
[*] Altered the box in 7-4 to be partially magnetic
[*] Boxes in 6-? are now the correct color based on position on level selection
[*] Magnet canceling now makes more intuitive sense
[*] Removed excess box movements for some levels
[*] Altered levels are now marked with a * on level selection when uncleared after updating
[*] Fixed a bug where the cursor could get stuck on a locked level.
[*] Centered Level Numbers above 9
[*] Magnet Hitboxes now display when in f3 menu
[*] Added version number to Menu
[*] Added collision to UI elements when accessible in a bonus level 
[*] Ice now correctly displays below all level elements
[*] Non-magnetic boxes now highlight correctly when on a goal
[*] Fixed a bug where boxes would ignore collision a single tile away if teleported onto an ice tile (W7)
[*] Added mouse hover effects to main menu buttons
[*] Music can now be toggled separately to SFX
[*] Fixed a bug where completing multiple levels more than could unlock World 0 prematurely 
[*] Added an indicator for where Teleport Tiles send boxes
[*] [spoiler]Added 8-?[/spoiler]


[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.6
notes.content:
Just a small update fixing a few things.
Thanks to Na for finding that 6-2 and 0-8 were impossible and proposing a solution.

- Reworked 6-1 to make it more interesting.
- Added a move to the box in 6-2 to make it possible
- Added a power box to 0-8 to make it possible
- Added Na to the credits under Extra Thanks
- World 0 level tint now displays as it was not showing before
- ? levels and World 8 now have the correct wall tint color
- 1-? now displays the correct UI element
